summary: Verified the riporto chain fix (_riporto_mese). Backend: 4/4 pytest pass. Gravedona Aug-Dec: each month's riporto equals the previous month's da_versare (Sep 1278.84, Oct 3323.84, Nov and Dec 6368.84), riporto_auto=true. Morbegno: Sep has the manual 833 (riporto_auto=false), Oct 110.60, Nov 5970.50. Sondrio: Oct, Nov and Dec all 8.90. Tirano TEST scenario: corrispettivo 100 gives Nov da_versare=100 and Dec riporto=100; versato-dopo of 40 gives 60; manual 55 gives 55 with riporto_auto=false; DELETE goes back to 60. Cleanup done (Tirano DB empty again). Frontend: on Gravedona, October shows riporto 3323.84 with the note 'riporto automatico non versato Settembre 2026' and the AUTOMATICO badge, and 'Da versare € 6368,84'. November shows riporto 6368.84.

minor.issue: Edge case: if a store has a manual riporto in month X but NO corrispettivi ever, from X+2 onwards (with X+1 empty) the riporto drops to 0. The 'never had data' check only looks at db.corrispettivi, not corrispettivi_mese.riporto, spese or versati.

A negative balance (ammanco) in the previous month is clamped to 0, not carried as a negative. This looks intentional but differs from the literal rule 'riporto = da_versare M-1'. Recursion can do up to 36 levels x 3 queries per GET (performance).

issues: eur() amounts have no thousands separator: shows '€ 3323,84' instead of '€ 3.323,84' as in the request
Date fields use the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: (Optional) Format eur() with a thousands separator (it-IT)
(Optional) Handle the edge case where a manual riporto has no corrispettivi before it
critical_code_review_comments: Tirano does not share corrispettivi with admin (403). The test temporarily inserts contabilita_config{condividi_admin:true, TEST:true} and removes it in teardown.

When test_iter40 and test_iter41 run in the same session, iter40 fails with login errors: the TOTP code is reused within the same 30 s window (replay protection). This is not a product bug; run the files separately or wait 30 s.
seed_data_creation: Only temporary TEST data on Tirano (corrispettivo 2026-11-03, versato-dopo, manual riporto, config doc), all removed. DB check confirms Tirano has 0 corrispettivi, 0 corrispettivi_mese, no config.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_iter41_riporto_catena.py -n0. Admin login needs TOTP (pyotp). In the UI, periodo-anno is an input (fill), periodo-mese is a select, contabilita-store-select is a select. The riporto value is in the input data-testid=riporto-importo.
